newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian carrier says Jan-Aug traffic up 18 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian carrier says Jan-Aug traffic up 18 pct.

text.p: Croatia Airlines d.d. said on Wednesday its January and August figures showed the number of passengers going up 18 percent to 554,740 from the first eight months of 1995.
Cargo and mail traffic rose six percent to 3,182 tonnes, compared to a year-ago period, it said in a press release.
The passenger load factor (PLF) was up to 58.3 from 53.9 percent in the two months from the end of June. This was seen by the company as "significantly boosting overall business".
"These are by far the best results in the brief but very complicated and dynamic development of Croatia Airlines," it said.

The first-half profit after costs was estimated to reach almost $0.5 million on over $50 million in total turnover, thanks to a boom in summer traffic. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
